title: tilia dasystyla subsp. caucasica
intro: Tilia dasystyla subsp. caucasica, commonly known as Caucasian Lime Tree, is a subspecies of the Tilia dasystyla tree, belonging to the Tiliaceae family. This deciduous tree is valued for its fragrant flowers, which are rich in bioactive constituents and provide numerous health benefits, including reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Tilia dasystyla subsp. caucasica include its sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils. The bioactive constituents of this plant, particularly its flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions.
